'''Antitamper field''' was an energy-draining component of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], R2-D2 used the antitamper field against the energy beings known as [[Melter]]s.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
